plan.title: Post-auction counter offer visible to vendor

steps.note: Open the prepared live converted-auction response screen containing the vendor's active bid.
Send the buyer's counter offer at the specified counter price.
Verify the buyer's Responses grid marks the vendor bid as having a counter offer.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the live auction pricing round where the vendor can review the counter offer.
Verify the vendor portal displays the pending counter offer.
Verify the vendor has an actionable accept option.
Verify the vendor has an actionable reject option.
Verify the vendor has an actionable modify option.
